semantic_corrections: Narrative says WaveTrend uses standard deviation; exact Pine code uses EMA of absolute deviation abs(ap-esa).
Narrative/comment says TP/SL 3500/7000 pips generally; exact code uses BUY 300/700 and SELL 3500/7000 multiplied by pipValue.
obLevel1/obLevel2/osLevel1/osLevel2 are plotted WaveTrend levels and are not the RSI entry thresholds; entry RSI thresholds are hard-coded 30 and 70.
buyTPCondition and sellTPCondition are assigned but never used to gate strategy.exit.
Fibonacci extrema are cumulative from script start via persistent fibLow/fibHigh; they are not rolling-window extrema.
strategy.exit is called every bar with levels derived from that bar close, so source management levels are dynamically re-anchored rather than fixed once at entry.

source_signal.buy: RSI(close,14)<30 AND close<fib38 AND close<fib50 AND close<fib618 AND crossover(wt1,wt2)
source_signal.sell: RSI(close,14)>70 AND close>fib38 AND close>fib50 AND close>fib618 AND crossunder(wt1,wt2)
